scripts.title: Axon Hub | Auto Loot, Multi Cast, ESP & Auto Potions
scripts.features:
Axon Hub for The Veil combines Auto Loot, Auto Open Chests, Multi Cast, detailed ESP, and automatic potion management. Customize item collection, track valuable drops, manage your weapons, and travel between unlocked waypoints from one organized menu.

AUTO LOOT & CHESTS

- Auto Collect — walk to nearby pickups and collect them automatically.
- Silver Collection — focus on silver or collect it alongside item drops.
- Adjustable Search Range — control how far the collector searches.
- Minimum Rarity — filter registered item drops by your chosen rarity.
- Unknown Item Filter — choose whether to collect items missing from the registry.
- Auto Open Chests — walk to nearby chests and open them automatically.
- Separate Chest Range — customize chest searching independently.
- Collect Nearest Now — manually trigger collection of the closest eligible pickup.

MULTI CAST & WEAPONS

- Multi Cast — activate multiple selected weapons together.
- Weapon Selection — choose owned cast weapons, melee weapons, or a mixed selection.
- Cast On Click — activate your selected weapons with a single click.
- Auto Cast — repeat casting at an adjustable interval.
- Keep Weapons Equipped — automatically re-equip selected weapons.
- Refresh Weapon List — update available choices after inventory changes.

ESP & VISIBILITY

- Drop ESP — highlight items with rarity-based colors.
- Monster ESP — locate nearby monsters.
- Chest ESP — highlight chests independently of item rarity filters.
- Player ESP — distinguish teammates from other players.
- Customize ESP range, distance labels, and maximum highlights.
- Filter displayed drops by rarity or include unknown items.
- Fullbright, No Fog, and options to remove darkness, blur, and flashbang overlays.

AUTO POTIONS

- Auto Heal — use Quick Heal below your selected health percentage.
- Auto Buff — trigger Quick Buff at a configurable interval.
- Auto Sanity Potion — consume an available potion when sanity reaches your threshold.
- Auto Nightcall Potion — refresh the Nightcall buff after it expires.
- Potion automation uses your available consumables.

MOVEMENT & TRAVEL

- Adjustable WalkSpeed and JumpPower.
- No Slowdown, Infinite Jump, and adjustable Fly speed.
- Client-side No Stun and No Ragdoll options.
- Custom field of view and maximum camera zoom.
- No Clip Camera — prevent walls from pulling the camera inward.
- Travel to unlocked waypoints, with an optional Omniwarp mode.

ALERTS & UTILITIES

- Boss spawn and defeat notifications.
- Rare Drop Alerts with adjustable rarity and detection range.
- Build the Item Registry for rarity filtering and rare-drop alerts.
- Export item rarities and monster drop information.
- Track session changes in kills, Silver, Ichor, Offerings, Prestige, and Sins.
- Server Hop, Rejoin, and Copy Job ID.
- Save and load your preferred configurations.
